label: HPE OfficeConnect 1405 5G v3 (JH407A)
notes: Vendor figures for **JH407A**: 5 autosensing 10/100/1000 ports, **unmanaged and unpowered**, fanless metal case, wall-mountable. The 1405 v3 series is the cheapest way onto gigabit and it does nothing else - no VLANs, no management, no PoE.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1405 8G v3 (JH408A)
notes: Vendor figures for **JH408A**: 8 autosensing 10/100/1000 ports, unmanaged, fanless, no PoE. **144 Gbps switching capacity** on a box with no management plane - the number is real and irrelevant, which is the honest way to read unmanaged switch datasheets.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 5G (JH327A)
notes: Vendor figures for **JH327A**: 5 x 10/100/1000 ports, unmanaged Layer 2, **no PoE** (the -PoE+ variant is JH328A). Green feature and EEE compliant, fanless.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 5G PoE+ 32W (JH328A)
description: 5-port gigabit PoE+ unmanaged switch: 5x 1G, 4x PoE+, 32 W budget.
notes: Vendor figures for **JH328A**: 5 gigabit ports, **PoE+ (802.3at) on 4 of them**, total budget **32 W**. **32 W across four PoE+ ports is 8 W each** - it will run four phones or two 802.3at access points, and it will not run four 30 W devices no matter what the port count suggests.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 8G (JH329A)
notes: Vendor figures for **JH329A**: 8 x 10/100/1000 ports, unmanaged Layer 2, no PoE, fanless.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 16G (JH016A)
notes: Vendor figures for **JH016A**: 16 x 10/100/1000 ports, unmanaged Layer 2, no PoE, rack-mountable 1U.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 24G (JG708B)
notes: Vendor figures for **JG708B**: 24 x 10/100/1000 ports, unmanaged Layer 2, no PoE. The JG708B revision is the current 24G; the 2SFP and 2SFP+ variants below are different part numbers, not options on this one.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 24G 2SFP (JH017A)
description: 24-port gigabit unmanaged switch with 2x 1G SFP: 24x 1G + 2x SFP.
notes: Vendor figures for **JH017A**: 24 x 10/100/1000 copper plus **2 SFP 100/1000 slots**, unmanaged, no PoE. The SFP slots are **1G only** - the -2SFP+ part (JH018A) is the one with 10G uplinks.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1420 24G 2SFP+ (JH018A)
description: 24-port gigabit unmanaged switch with 2x 10G SFP+: 24x 1G + 2x SFP+ 10G.
notes: Vendor figures for **JH018A**: 24 x 10/100/1000 copper plus **2 SFP+ 10G uplinks** - **10G on an unmanaged switch**, which is the unusual part: it aggregates a lab into a 10G core without ever offering a VLAN or a CLI to configure the link.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 8G (J9979A)
notes: Vendor figures for **J9979A**: 8 x 10/100/1000 ports, smart-managed through a **web UI only** (no CLI), fanless, no PoE.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 8G PoE+ 65W (J9982A)
description: 8-port gigabit smart-managed PoE+ switch: 8x 1G, 4x PoE+, 65 W budget.
notes: Vendor figures for **J9982A**: 8 gigabit ports with **4 ports of PoE+ and a 65 W budget**. Half the ports are unpowered - a pattern that repeats across this whole range and is not obvious from the model name.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 24G (J9980A)
description: 24-port gigabit smart-managed switch with 2x SFP: 24x 1G + 2x SFP, no PoE.
notes: Vendor figures for **J9980A**: 24 autosensing 10/100/1000 ports plus **2 SFP 100/1000 slots**, web-managed, no PoE.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 24G PoE+ 185W (J9983A)
description: 24-port gigabit smart-managed switch: 12x 1G PoE+ + 12x 1G, 2x SFP, 185 W budget.
notes: Vendor figures for **J9983A**: **12 RJ-45 PoE+ ports, 12 RJ-45 non-PoE ports, 2 SFP**, budget **185 W**. **Half of the twenty-four ports cannot power anything** - the model name says "24G PoE+" and the datasheet says twelve, which is exactly the kind of gap that ruins a camera plan after the switch is installed.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1820 48G (J9981A)
description: 48-port gigabit smart-managed switch with 4x SFP: 48x 1G + 4x SFP, no PoE.
notes: Vendor figures for **J9981A**: 48 x 10/100/1000 ports plus **4 SFP 100/1000 slots** (non-combo, so fibre does not cost a copper port), web-managed, no PoE.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1920S 48G 4SFP (JL382A)
description: 48-port gigabit smart-managed L3 switch with 4x SFP: 48x 1G + 4x SFP, no PoE.
notes: Vendor figures for **JL382A**: 48 x 10/100/1000 ports plus 4 SFP, static L3 routing, web UI and limited CLI. **Superseded by the JL685A** - the request came in for a part Aruba has replaced, so the entry stays under the original SKU with this note rather than pretending to be the successor.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1950 24G 2SFP+ 2XGT (JG960A)
description: 24-port gigabit L3 switch with 2x 10G SFP+ and 2x 10GBASE-T: 24x 1G + 2x SFP+ + 2x 10G copper.
notes: Vendor figures for **JG960A**: **24 x 1G RJ-45, 2 x SFP+ 10G, 2 x 10GBASE-T** - ten-gigabit on both fibre and copper, Layer 3 managed. The 10GBASE-T ports are the useful half in a room that never got fibre.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1950 24G PoE+ 2SFP+ 2XGT (JG962A)
description: 24-port gigabit L3 PoE+ switch: 24x 1G all PoE+ (370 W) + 2x SFP+ + 2x 10G copper.
notes: Vendor figures for **JG962A**: 24 x 1G **all PoE+**, **370 W budget**, 2 x SFP+ 10G and 2 x 10GBASE-T. **370 W across 24 ports is 15 W average** - twelve 30 W access points would need 360 W and fit, thirteen would not.

label: HPE OfficeConnect 1950 48G PoE+ 2SFP+ 2XGT (JG963A)
description: 48-port gigabit L3 PoE+ switch: 48x 1G all PoE+ (370 W) + 2x SFP+ + 2x 10G copper.
notes: Vendor figures for **JG963A**: 48 x 1G all PoE+, 2 x SFP+ 10G, 2 x 10GBASE-T, **370 W budget - the same budget as the 24-port JG962A**. **Doubling the port count did not double the power**: 370 W across 48 ports is 7.7 W average, so it is a phone switch, not a 48-camera switch.
